page.notes: The reading "Consumma-matum" at the line break is uncertain; the hyphenation was copied as printed. The word after "neque" reads "istuc" but is doubtful, and the italic/roman boundaries in the dense italic passages are approximate. The signature on the right of the foot ("Dd" followed by a mark, probably "ij" or "iij") is not legible enough to copy. Left edge shows binding shadow and was ignored.
